techniques.evidence: app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineMoveTargets.ts:31 Entering the terminal stage is refused by role, but leaving it is offered. The technique requires a move whose source is terminal to be refused, with reversal as a separate named action.

app/features/hiring/pipeline/pipelineBoardLayout.ts:75 Stranded entries are not folded into column 0 (bucketLaneEntries). They are surfaced separately and kept in the prev/next reading order, so they stay reachable as well as visible.

techniques.evidence: app/features/hiring/pipeline/usePipelineFilters.ts:69 rg finds no non-test caller of resolveStageFilter and no tsx that reads stageFilter. The filter is held, which is correct, but the notice is never rendered.

pairs.subject: pipeline-stage-modelling
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/pipeline-entry-action.ts:408 set_stage refuses only a terminal TARGET. A Hired candidate keeps status 'active' (pipeline-status.ts header), and setPipelineEntryStage refuses only terminal STATUSES, so a manual move out of the terminal stage is accepted and recorded as an ordinary 'moved' event with no reversal action.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/pipeline-entry-action.ts:408 The target guard is role-based and the accept-path guard (acceptWouldReachTerminal) is good. There is no source-is-terminal refusal, so terminal is not absorbing.

app/_lib/pipeline-status.ts:82 The candidate-facing interview-reminder rule compares the literal 'Hired' id instead of the terminal role. Its written justification is module purity, not a failure triage, and the technique says notifications select on role. Elsewhere the context resolves by role (stageHasRole at pipeline-stages.ts:142).

app/_lib/pipeline-stages.ts:194 The gate is derived correctly by role, the comparison is inclusive, and the screening set is the entry+screening roles intersected with the gate (line 221). But the predicate takes only live stages, so a row on a retired interview/offer column resolves to -1 and counts as never advanced. That is the tombstone case the technique names.

app/_lib/pipeline-axis.ts:73 Ids on neither the live nor the retired list are computed for surfacing rather than folded into column 0. The scorecard reroute also excludes off-axis stages instead of guessing (entry-action line ~488).

app/_lib/pipeline-axis.ts:60 Retired stages stay resolvable by id with their label and role (findStage), and the store accepts them as a place to stand. The gap is that measures do not read them, which is recorded under screening-gate-index.
